title: Run final GitHub public readiness gate

context.summary: Execute the final public release gate from a fresh clone perspective.
context.background: Before publishing, Mindory must prove checks, install bootstrap, release artifacts, live self-host and documentation are coherent.

in: Run fresh-clone checks for pnpm install assumptions, pnpm check and release validation.
Verify the public-readiness debt gate has no remaining task-owned markers.
Update changelog, repository status and release checklist.
out: Actually pushing to GitHub unless explicitly requested.

acceptance_criteria: pnpm check passes from a clean checkout.
No supported-path temporary markers remain in the public-readiness debt gate.
git status is clean before publication handoff.

manual_checks: Confirm README and release notes are sufficient for a new GitHub user.
Confirm no secrets or local machine paths are committed.

risks: The final gate may reveal environment-specific Docker or installer issues that need separate fixes.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
